description: Designs the Kafka producer/consumer adapter for an already-modeled domain event — topic, partition key, serialization, consumer group, delivery semantics, retries and DLQ, and the AsyncAPI contract a consumer outside the project reads — into the `25-messaging.md` partial. Use when the request involves publishing a domain event to Kafka, consuming a Kafka topic, designing a producer or consumer adapter, deciding topic/partition/serialization, wiring retry/DLQ for a message listener, or documenting the asynchronous contract (AsyncAPI, Springwolf). Piece of the `/new-feature` pipeline: requires `10-domain.md` in the given folder with an Events block that names external delivery, and stops without it.
